scenarios.title: A creature with skulk cannot be blocked by a creature with greater power

setup.notes: Furtive Homunculus (2/1 skulk) has been declared as an attacker against B and the declare blockers step has begun. B's only creature is untapped.

decisions: A attacks B with Furtive Homunculus in the declare attackers step.
B proposes to block Furtive Homunculus with its one creature; the engine's verdict on that block is read.

variants.label: greater_power
variants.expected: The block is illegal: Centaur Courser (power 3) has greater power than Furtive Homunculus (power 2), so it is not a legal blocker.

variants.label: equal_power
variants.delta: B's creature is Grizzly Bears (power 2) instead of Centaur Courser (power 3).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Grizzly Bears has power equal to Furtive Homunculus's, which skulk does not restrict.

variants.label: lesser_power
variants.delta: B's creature is Llanowar Elves (power 1) instead of Centaur Courser (power 3).
variants.expected: The block is legal: Llanowar Elves has less power than Furtive Homunculus.
